limitations: ARC is zero in ~80% of cells: high precision, low recall, ~5.7% of a typical cell.
Compare within rows only. Column totals are not comparable; gods differ in breadth.
Aurora's entire row spans ~10 points. No god fits; the choice is near-arbitrary.
Belle's true analogue is Psyche and Snow White's is Persephone. Neither is an Olympian.
The ARC/ICO balance is the most consequential parameter. Test conclusions across a range.
